overall_vibe: Authoritative, pristine, AI-native, highly productive, and visually sharp. Follows 2026 SaaS design patterns: modular bento-box layouts, progressive disclosure, and integrated AI capabilities.

rules: Use stark white backgrounds for core reading/content areas to maintain the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' authority.
Use a 10% grey tint (e.g., #F8FAFC) for app background outside cards, allowing crisp white cards to stand out.
Primary brand color is Electric Blue; reserve Accent Orange (#F97316) exclusively for AI-generated actions (e.g., 'Generate AI Post', 'AI Suggestion').
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use #0A0A0A (Obsidian) for ultimate text readability.

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (for API keys, technical tags, algorithms)
rules: Headings MUST use tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Metrics and KPIs MUST use heavy weights (font-black or font-extrabold).
Labels over inputs and charts must be uppercase with wide spacing (tracking-[0.15em]).
Ensure proper fallback for Arabic fonts to maintain readability in RTL.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Dense & Modular. Rely on the 'Control Room' bento grid pattern for dashboards to ensure high data scanability. Avoid sprawling empty spaces on analytical views.

patterns.dashboard_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 md:gap-6

rules: Grid items MUST be direct children of the grid container.
Cards should have a flat background (bg-white), a crisp 1px border (border border-slate-200), and NO shadow by default. Add a subtle shadow on hover.
Sidebar should be vertical on the start (left for LTR, right for RTL) and collapsible for max horizontal screen space.

rtl_guidelines.strategy: Native Bi-directional Support via Flexbox/Grid and CSS Logical Properties.
implementation: DO NOT use absolute directional classes like 'ml-4', 'pr-2', 'pl-4'.
Flex directions handle RTL natively. Use 'justify-start', 'justify-end' instead of 'justify-left', 'justify-right'.
Toggle direction globally by setting <html dir='rtl' lang='ar'>.

cards.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-6 overflow-hidden

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.ai_action: bg-orange-500 text-white hover:bg-orange-600 font-semibold rounded-md px-4 py-2 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(249,115,22,0.3)] transition-all flex items-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200 border border-transparent font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.outline: bg-transparent text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors

inputs.style: bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 rounded-md px-3 py-2

badges.style: inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold

icons.style: Use 20px (w-5 h-5) for standard icons, 16px (w-4 h-4) for dense list icons. Stroke width 2.

third_party.charts: recharts (Line charts for trends, Donut for multi-platform distribution)

event_motaz.description: Motaz 2-day live on stage background / header image.

event_excellence.description: Excellence Camp / Business Camp event background image.

pages.name: Global Admin Dashboard
pages.layout: Sidebar navigation (LTR/RTL responsive). Top nav with Bilingual (EN/AR) toggle switch.
features: KPI Widgets (row 1): Total Leads, Total Revenue, Global Engagement, Meetings Booked.
Events List Overview: Cards for 'Motaz Live', 'Excellence Camp', 'Business Camp', 'Virtual Ramadan'.
Recent AI Posts Activity Feed: Showing approvals/rejections.

pages.name: Event Sub-Dashboard (e.g., Motaz 2-day live)
features: Hero section showing the event_motaz image with a transparent-to-black gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 to-transparent) + Event Title & Dates.
Metrics (KPI): New Leads, Leads Filled Form, Meetings Booked, Purchases, No-Shows.
Budget Tracker Widget: Planned vs Actual Budget (Bar chart) + Real-time ROI.
Audience Segmentation Widget: Warm/Cold Leads, Follower/Non-follower split.

pages.name: AI Content & Campaign Builder
pages.layout: Two-pane layout. Left pane: Prompt/Inputs. Right pane: Visual Preview (2026 UI Pattern).
features: Left Pane: Target Audience selectors (Age, Gender, Geo), Algorithm MCP goals (Max Reach vs Conversion), Prompt textarea.
Right Pane: AI Output stream. Suggests posts with specific formatting (Video script vs Text).
Approval Flow: Each AI generated block has 'Approve', 'Edit', 'Reject' buttons.
Platform selectors: Meta, YouTube Ads, WhatsApp, Email FOMO templates.

pages.name: Admin Settings & Integrations
pages.layout: Settings Layout with vertical tabs (Profile, Users, AI Keys, Social Accounts, CRM Integrations).
features: User Management: Add users, assign permissions.
LLM API Keys Config: Secure input fields for Google Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude.
Social Accounts Config: OAuth connection blocks for Meta/YouTube/TikTok.
GoHighLevel CRM Integration: Webhook & API key setup, tag mapping (e.g., mapping 'Purchased' tags to CRM workflows).

data_testid_guidelines.rule: Every interactive and key informational element MUST have a unique data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. No arbitrary colors.
Ensure RTL is implemented using CSS logical properties. Do NOT hardcode left/right margins/paddings unless explicitly required.
Use standard HTML+Tailwind for main layouts, and rely on Shadcn components for complex interactions like Modals, Tables, Forms, Selects.
Build the dashboard pages using the Bento grid rules provided.
Inject the media URLs provided in 'image_urls' exactly as provided. Do not use generic placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
Ensure the language toggle actually wraps the app or triggers <html dir='rtl'> for Arabic and <html dir='ltr'> for English.
Prioritize Recharts for all analytical data displays.
